title: P5 Enrich seed data with realistic mock data
description:
Replace hand-crafted seed with richer realistic data using Faker.js.

REALISTIC TURBINE MODELS (use in seed):
- Vestas: V90-3.0 MW, V110-2.0 MW, V164-9.5 MW
- Siemens Gamesa: SG 14-222 DD, SWT-3.6-120, SG 8.0-167 DD
- GE: 1.5sle, 2.75-120, Haliade-X 13 MW
- Enercon: E-126 EP4 7.5 MW, E-115 3.0 MW

REAL FAILURE DATA (OREDA/industry sources):
- Gearbox: ~20% of downtime, MTBF ~5 years
- Blades: ~15%, MTBF ~7 years
- Electrical systems: ~12%, MTBF ~3 years
- Generator: ~10%, MTBF ~6 years
- Pitch system: ~8%, MTBF ~4 years
- Yaw system: ~5%, MTBF ~8 years

DATA SOURCES:
- USGS Wind Turbine Database: 70K+ real US turbines with coords, capacities, manufacturers (usgs.gov)
- Open Power System Data (open-power-system-data.org): wind farm metadata, generation curves
- NREL (nrel.gov): wind resource data, turbine specs, reliability datasets
- Faker.js: realistic names, addresses, companies, timestamps
- Synthesize failure timestamps using Weibull distribution for wear-out patterns

SCOPE:
- 50+ users across roles (technician, dispatcher, admin, manager)
- 100+ tickets with realistic failure descriptions per component
- Work orders linked to tickets
- Inspections with findings
- Audit log entries
- Real turbine hierarchy: site → 50-100 turbines → subsystems → OEM-correct components
- Realistic org/site names using actual wind farm regions

title: P5 API: Exportable reports (CSV/JSON)
description: Report generation endpoints: compliance reports, inspection summaries, work order completion rates, technician productivity. Export as CSV or JSON. Date range and org/site filters.

title: P5 API: Audit trail and activity log
description: Audit trail endpoints: list all changes (who, what, when, before/after). Query by entity type, entity ID, user, date range. AuditLog model already in schema. Soft-delete safe — log deletions.

title: P5 API: Advanced search and filters
description: Full-text search across tickets, work orders, inspections, assets. Filter by status, priority, date range, assignee, site, turbine. Support sort and pagination. Reuse existing cursor pagination pattern.

title: P5 API: Dashboard stats and KPIs
description: Dashboard endpoints: system overview (counts by status), org/site/turbine-level stats, open tickets by priority, work orders by status, technician utilization. Aggregation queries via Prisma.

title: P5 Phase 5: Reporting and Audit
description: Dashboards, search/filters, audit trail, exportable reports. Parent for phase 5 sub-tasks.

title: P4 API: Technician availability, dispatch, and replacements
description: Build technician availability routes: list technicians with status, update status, record absence, absence history, assignments. Build dispatch board: coverage view, SLA risk, assign endpoint. Build replacement suggestions: ranked candidates with scoring, execute reassignment, accept/decline. Models: AvailabilitySlot, AbsenceRecord, Assignment, ReplacementSuggestion. See MVP_API_Specification.md sections 12-14.

title: P4 API: Work orders CRUD
description: Build work order routes: create from ticket, list, get, update, status transitions, soft delete. Model: WorkOrder, WorkOrderEvidence. Similar lifecycle to tickets. See MVP_API_Specification.md section 11.

title: P4 API: Tickets CRUD with state machine
description: Build ticket routes: create (optionally from defect), list, get detail, status transitions (NEW→TRIAGED→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→PENDING_REVIEW→CLOSED, CLOSED→REOPENED), assign with skill validation, close with resolution, reopen, link evidence, audit trail. Models: Ticket, Defect, TicketEvidence. See MVP_API_Specification.md section 10.

title: P4 Phase 4: Ticketing and Workforce
description: Ticket generation from defects, work orders, technician availability, absence management, replacement suggestions, dispatcher board. See MVP_API_Specification.md sections 10-14.

title: P3 API: Sync engine (push/pull/status)
description: Build sync routes: push batch changes, pull changes since timestamp, get sync status. Model: SyncEvent. Handles version conflicts, batch processing, and per-entity sync status. Auth: user syncs own records. See MVP_API_Specification.md section 8.

title: P3 API: Evidence management and upload
description: Build evidence routes: presigned upload URL, create evidence metadata, list/search evidence, get single evidence, annotations. Models: EvidenceItem, EvidenceAnnotation, TicketEvidence, WorkOrderEvidence. Auth: technician uploads, all roles can view. See MVP_API_Specification.md section 9.

title: P3 API: Inspection records CRUD with workflow
description: Build inspection record routes: create, list, get, update field data, submit/approve/reject workflow. Models: InspectionRecord, InspectionFieldData. Status flow: ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→SUBMITTED→APPROVED/REJECTED/CHANGES_REQUESTED. Auth: technician creates/updates, QA reviews. See MVP_API_Specification.md section 7.

title: P3 Phase 3: Field Capture
description: Build mobile inspection forms, evidence management, and sync engine. Sub-tasks: 3.1 inspection records, 3.2 evidence, 3.3 sync.
close_reason: All sub-tasks completed: 3.1 inspection records, 3.2 evidence management, 3.3 sync engine

title: API: Admin endpoints (users, skills, certifications)
description: Admin-only CRUD for users, skills, certifications. POST /admin/users, skill/cert assignment endpoints. User activation/deactivation. Workflow rules CRUD stub. Tests.

title: API: Inspection templates + versions
description: CRUD for inspection templates with versioned JSON schema fields. POST /templates, GET /templates/:id, version management (POST /templates/:id/versions). Field types: TEXT, NUMERIC, PASS_FAIL, DROPDOWN, PHOTO, VIDEO, SIGNATURE. Admin-only writes. Tests.

title: API: Turbine + Subsystem + Component CRUD
description: REST endpoints for asset hierarchy below site level. Turbine CRUD with IEC 61400-25 name validation. Subsystem and component CRUD. Asset history endpoint GET /assets/:id/history. Error codes ASSET_004-006. Tests.

title: API: Organization + Site CRUD
description: REST endpoints for organizations and sites hierarchy. GET/POST/PUT/DELETE with cursor pagination, soft deletes, role guards (admin-only writes). Error codes ASSET_001-003. Tests.

title: DB: Prisma migrations + seed data
description: Run initial Prisma migration against local PostgreSQL. Create seed script with org, sites, turbines, subsystems, components, users (one per role), skills, certifications. Seed data per MVP_Database_Schema.md section 6. Verify with prisma studio.
close_reason: Initial Prisma migration applied (29 tables). Seed script created with 2 orgs, 3 sites, 5 turbines, 20 subsystems, 90 components, 5 users (one per role), 5 skills, 4 certs. All 46 existing tests pass.

title: Auth: JWT login/refresh/logout + role middleware
description: Implement POST /auth/login, POST /auth/refresh, POST /auth/logout, GET /auth/me. JWT access + refresh tokens. Role-based middleware for Hono route protection. bcrypt password hashing. Tests for all endpoints.

title: Phase 2: Core Foundation
description: Build auth, DB schema, asset registry, inspection templates, and admin screens
close_reason: All sub-tasks completed: 2.2 db migration, 2.4 asset CRUD, 2.5 inspection templates, 2.6 admin endpoints

value: Audit trail routes in src/routes/audit.ts — 3 endpoints: GET /audit (list with filters), GET /audit/:id (single event), GET /audit/entity/:entityType/:entityId (entity-scoped). Auth: admin/ops for list+detail, dispatcher/QA for entity-scoped. 13 tests.

Ticket state machine transitions: NEW→TRIAGED→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→PENDING_REVIEW→CLOSED, CLOSED→REOPENED→TRIAGED. PENDING_REVIEW can also go back to IN_PROGRESS. Assign auto-transitions NEW/TRIAGED to ASSIGNED. Close clears resolution_notes/root_cause/closed_at on reopen.

Dispatch/availability routes split across 3 files: technicians.ts (CRUD + status + absence + assignments + replacement-suggestions), replacements.ts (execute/accept/decline), dispatch.ts (coverage/sla-risk/assign). Auth: tech can update own status, dispatcher/admin for dispatch ops.

Sync engine uses dynamic prisma table lookup via entityTableMap for INSPECTION/TICKET/WORK_ORDER/EVIDENCE. Version conflict detection compares client version vs server version. SyncEvent model tracks per-entity sync status.
